evidence.title: GitHub - GoogleChromeLabs/squoosh: Make images smaller using best-in-class codecs, right in the browser. · GitHub

name: Squoosh
summary: Image compression web app that shrinks images with different codecs entirely in the browser.
description: Drop or paste an image, inspect the compressed result against the original and save it, or adjust settings for even smaller files. Processing runs locally: images are never sent to a server. Open-source on GitHub under Apache-2.0 (~26k stars).
contains: compress and compare images with different codecs in the browser
images never leave the device, all compression runs locally
open source on GitHub: Apache-2.0, ~26k stars
drop, paste or pick a sample image; save instantly or tune settings
